page_summary:
Time Out of Joint is the canonical works record for PKD's novel. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is Time Out of Joint (1959). The archive copy runs 155 pages.

Researchers can use this entry to trace publication context, later commentary, and relationships to other works.

biography_events.event: The 1126 Francisco St house dream (the "fake world" of *Joint*).
Finding the "wisdom entity" in the world.
Realizing he was programmed to die in Aug '74.
Realizing his writing career was a "surmise and search" completed by 3-74.
The "Golden Fish" sign (2-74) as the trigger for pistis (faith).
